answer: Each identity claims one garden plot and locks 70 credits. Its kernel is five randomly assigned neighbors, beacon-fixed, never self-picked. To activate, three neighbors must co-sign a cedar-sealed attestation of a fresh task; the seal stays public. A neighbor attesting a fake loses its own bond. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x (70 + 3 x 25) = 145,000 for 40,000; bought rings show as adjacent clusters in the garden registry. An honest agent pays 70 once.
